job.title: Lead Full Stack Developer - SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies (m/w/d)

tailoring.headline: Lead Full Stack Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies (5+ yrs SAP Commerce)
tailoring.summary: Backend developer with 5+ years delivering enterprise e-commerce solutions on SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2105/2211) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Expert in Java, Spring, Spring Boot, REST/OCC APIs, micro-services and integration of PIM, ERP and MDM systems. Proven record in CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, production support and code reviews. Techno-functional consultant skilled in requirements analysis, user stories and AI-assisted development. SAP Certified Commerce Cloud Developer.

APIs & Integration: PIM / ERP / MDM integration (Profisee, SAP ERP)

cover_en.subject: Application: Lead Full Stack Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies
cover_en.hook: I am excited by Busch Vacuum Solutions’ commitment to sustainable vacuum technology and its global impact. With 5+ years leading SAP Commerce Cloud projects at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I bring deep expertise in building scalable e-commerce platforms that align with your vision.

bullets.label: SAP Commerce Expertise
bullets.text: Designed and delivered end-to-end SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) solutions, implementing Java/Spring back-end and OCC REST APIs for global product and catalog management.

bullets.label: Full-Stack Development
bullets.text: Created and maintained both back-end services and front-end components, integrating PIM/ERP data pipelines and supporting modern web experiences for B2B/B2C customers.

bullets.label: Integration Leadership
bullets.text: Led cross-functional teams to integrate SAP ERP, MDM and Profisee systems, driving API migrations and ensuring data consistency across international rollouts.

bullets.label: Technical Standards & Mentoring
bullets.text: Conducted code reviews, established CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) and mentored junior developers, raising overall code quality and delivery speed.

cover_en.logistics: Based in Karlsruhe, Germany with a valid work permit. Serving notice until 15 December 2026; earliest start 16 December 2026. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute to your team.

cover_de.subject: Bewerbung als Lead Full Stack Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies
cover_de.hook: Die nachhaltige Ausrichtung von Busch Vacuum Solutions und die globale Reichweite begeistern mich. Mit über 5 Jahren Erfahrung in der Leitung von SAP Commerce Cloud-Projekten bei Rockwell Automation und Shell bringe ich fundiertes Know-how für skalierbare E-Commerce-Lösungen mit.

bullets.label: SAP-Commerce-Expertise
bullets.text: Entwarf und implementierte End-to-End-Lösungen auf SAP Commerce Cloud (Hybris 2211) mit Java/Spring-Back-end und OCC-REST-APIs für globale Produkt- und Katalogverwaltung.

bullets.label: Full-Stack-Entwicklung
bullets.text: Erstellte und wartete sowohl Back-end-Services als auch Front-end-Komponenten, integrierte PIM/ERP-Datenpipelines und unterstützte moderne Web-Erlebnisse für B2B- und B2C-Kunden.

bullets.label: Integrations-Leadership
bullets.text: Leitete funktionsübergreifende Teams bei der Integration von SAP ERP, MDM und Profisee, steuerte API-Migrationen und sicherte Datenkonsistenz in internationalen Rollouts.

bullets.label: Technische Standards & Mentoring
bullets.text: Führte Code-Reviews durch, etablierte CI/CD-Pipelines (Jenkins, Docker, Kubernetes) und coachte Junior-Entwickler, wodurch Code-Qualität und Liefergeschwindigkeit gesteigert wurden.

cover_de.logistics: Standort Karlsruhe, Deutschland, gültige Arbeitserlaubnis. Letzter Arbeitstag 15.12.2026, frühester Eintritt 16.12.2026. Ich freue mich auf ein Gespräch, um meinen Beitrag zu Ihrem Erfolg zu erläutern.

tailoring.why_company: Busch Vacuum Solutions combines cutting-edge vacuum technology with a strong sustainability focus—values that resonate with my passion for building robust, future-proof e-commerce platforms. Your global footprint and commitment to innovation provide the ideal environment for me to apply my SAP Commerce Cloud expertise and drive digital transformation across diverse industries.
tailoring.motivation_short: I want to leverage my SAP Commerce Cloud and full-stack experience to help Busch Vacuum Solutions accelerate its digital commerce and deliver sustainable, high-performance solutions worldwide.
tailoring.linkedin_message: Hi, I’m Kranti Chavan, a senior SAP Commerce Cloud developer with 5+ years of experience. I’m eager to discuss how I can contribute to Busch Vacuum Solutions’ Lead Full Stack role. Let’s connect!
tailoring.email_subject: Application for Lead Full Stack Developer – SAP Commerce Cloud & Web Technologies
tailoring.email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

Please find attached my CV and cover letter for the Lead Full Stack Developer position. With 5+ years of SAP Commerce Cloud experience at Rockwell Automation and Shell, I am ready to contribute to Busch Vacuum Solutions.

Kind regards,
Kranti Chavan
